tbesh_html:
1) to conceal, hide, be hidden, be concealed, be secret
1a) (Qal) secret (participle)
1b) (Niphal)
1b1) to be concealed
1b2) concealed, dissembler (participle)
1c) (Hiphil) to conceal, hide
1d) (Hithpael) to hide oneself

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to veil from sight, i.e. conceal (literally or figuratively)
strongs_1890.kjv_def: [idiom] any ways, blind, dissembler, hide (self), secret (thing).
